content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JIPMER Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER Project Technical Support – III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 09 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS/BDS/BAMS/BHMS degree along with a Master of Public Health (MPH). Proficiency in Tamil and English is also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support – III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support – III role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 33,600.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this JIPMER job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection methods for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Project Technical Support – III.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is this job located?
faq.answer: The job is located in Puducherry.
